objectives.text: Tell an image (a read-only, layered template) from a container (a running or stopped instance created from an image) in a described scenario
Predict what a given docker run or podman run command does: which image it starts, the container name, and the effect of -d and --rm

Explain that Podman runs the same OCI images, is daemonless on Linux but on macOS and Windows runs containers inside a Linux virtual machine started with podman machine, and accepts the same core build, run, ps and images commands used in this course

The module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator's P50 on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and raises budget and aboutLabel if the measured minimum is higher. See workflow/evidence/containers-cicd/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
